abstract: A 30-year-old woman who presented loss of consciousness was diagnosed as having large anterior mediastinal tumor. Computed tomography (CT) showed a 17.0×13.0×7.3 cm cystic mass with internal calcification in the anterior mediastinum that was markedly compressing the heart, great vessels, trachea and bronchi. A mature cystic teratoma was suspected, and the mediastinal tumor was resected through a median sternotomy. At the induction of anesthesia to prevent the development of the respiratory and circulatory collapse, the patient was consciously intubated under the right lateral decubitus position while preparing for percutaneous cardiopulmonary support by cardiac surgeons, and the surgery was safely performed. The tumor was pathologically diagnosed as a mature cystic teratoma, and symptoms such as loss of consciousness have disappeared.
abstract_ja: 意識消失を呈した30歳の女性が、大きな前縦隔腫瘍と診断された。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では、前縦隔に内部石灰化を伴う17.0×13.0×7.3cmの嚢胞性腫瘤が認められ、心臓、大血管、気管および気管支を著明に圧迫していた。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が疑われ、胸骨正中切開により縦隔腫瘍を切除した。呼吸循環虚脱を防ぐための麻酔導入時には、心臓外科医が経皮的心肺補助の準備を進める間、患者を右側臥位で意識下に挿管し、手術を安全に実施した。腫瘍は病理学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断され、意識消失などの症状は消失した。
